Aurora for Installers 
Get it right the first time, every time 
From lead to install, Aurora’s end-to-end platform empowers every team to deliver better designs, faster. 
 Scroll 
 to section below 
Aurora for Installers 
Eliminate change orders with one accurate design, from sale to install 
Industry-leading design technology 
Remote site assessment, LIDAR-based shade analysis, and AI-assisted 3D modeling give you pixel-perfect designs from start to finish. 
Solutions for the entire solar workflow 
Aurora's platform offers solutions for lead generation, design, and installation — all in one place — to prevent change orders at their source and build momentum through the project lifecycle. 
Flexible account configurations for every business 
Aurora’s collaboration solutions support any business model, including installer-dealer relationships and channel partners. 
Speed up design without sacrificing accuracy 
Forget about on-site shade measurements — Aurora’s irradiance engine provides statistically equivalent shade analysis values, instantly. 
 Learn more about our technology 
Expedite your post-sales process 
Aurora’s proprietary AHJ database and on-demand Plan Sets Service let you sell, design, and obtain AHJ-ready plan sets — including PE stamps — all within a single platform. 
 Learn more about Plan Sets 
Unify your dealers and systems 
Bring dealers onto the same Aurora account, empowering them to sell installable designs with custom settings for each partner, such as branding, pricing, and equipment. 
 Testimonials 
 Dean Scott 
 Director of Operations, Sunpro 
 We can now create a design for a home in a predetermined amount of time. When it becomes more of a push-of-a-button as opposed to an order, it definitely helps our efficiency. When that pipeline of jobs becomes exponentially bigger, it becomes more and more critical. 
 George Young 
 Director of Solar Development, Solar Energy Services 
 We’ve had 4 cases where customers didn’t agree with the measurements on the Aurora design that we presented virtually. We decided to go out to the site and measure the house by hand with the homeowner, and in every instance, Aurora was correct. They were actually wrong about the measurements of their own home. The accuracy of the Aurora software, combined with our willingness to put it to the test on-site, helped close the deal each time! 
 Jason Elseman 
 Project Engineer, Wellspring Components LLC 
 Submitting the plan set was as smooth as can be and we had no issues with the AHJ. Our team has already saved a ton of time with this service.
